entry.label: Bhaskar: mechanisms in open systems (Challoner, 2026)
entry.description: Challoner distinguishes what exists, what happens, and what is experienced. Mechanisms can operate without producing an isolated regularity. Social structures and agency are interdependent but distinct; this does not turn every retrospective explanation into a demonstrated mechanism.
